items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Norman Granz, her manager, had chartered a plane... Norman Granz stole me away from him.

ctx.x: Speaking about Ella's standing ovations, this was in Hamburg, Germany, and Norman Granz, her manager, had chartered a plane, and we could fly any time we wanted to fly, you know? We'd finished this concert and had gone back to our dressing rooms to change, to get on the plane, to change our clothes. And the audience came around the stage and surrounded the stage, and we had to come out and perform again. And I had a sweater on. At first I'd had a tuxedo. You know how you dress up to perform a show. And so we did…
